cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Not About Who Lost
cards.instruction: Keep the conversation focused on rules, effort, or next steps instead of the result that embarrasses you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Let's discuss our quiz preparation, not the final score.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. We identified the greatest number of learning opportunities.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: How many points did we get?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: First, appreciate how bravely we attempted the geography round.
